class_mapping: COCO category_id 1 mapped to YOLO class 0; single drone class
image_alert_definition: At least one prediction with confidence greater than or equal to the threshold
positive_image_alert_definition: A positive test image with at least one prediction above the confidence threshold; this does not guarantee correct localization
negative_image_false_alert_definition: An empty-ground-truth test image with at least one prediction above the confidence threshold
limitations: Threshold sweep is exploratory and uses the held-out test split; thresholds are not independently calibrated deployment settings.
Estimated review time assumes 10 seconds per alerted image and is not measured operator performance.
Video frames may be temporally adjacent and may represent repeated observations of the same drone.
Image-level alert presence does not establish correct bounding-box localization.
The experiment evaluates drone detection only, not armed-person detection.
The analysis does not establish real-world field deployment performance.
